title: The band at the dance house across Bayou Rapides
summary: A band of Pensacola Kid, Clarence Williams, Bunk Johnson and Baby Lovett works at a dance-hall house with girls across the bayou.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Never did play piano. He was a cat with a violin. I don't know, he might have could play piano, but I never did know him as a piano player. Well, Finney's telling him, I got this boy a job, Pensacola Kid, Clarence William, and Bunk Johnson. And Baby Lovett was playing with us. We let him have Baby and we took another drummer. Took little Jack Hine, that was Baby's friend. So they all went down and worked at this house together. They had a nice band. We could be on playing, you know, at night. Where were they playing?
What was the place? Huh? What was the place called where they worked? You know one name. Or house, wasn't it?
The house, yeah. Dance hall house. The dance hall with the girls too, huh? Yeah, with the girls.
Regular school. Eighteen girls and, uh.
Excuse me. Sure. Suppose I put the... Well, let's see, you were talking about that job there at Bunk and All Play.

Uh, Bunk and they were playing in a place, what town was that I got lost? Yeah, it was the only town across the Bayer. Why'd they call it that? Across the Bayer or something? It was across. Bayer Rapide. Right across on the other side.
Uh huh. Like a little island over there. Uh huh. Nothing but fast. Help people. I got the picture. Of it now. And that's where Bunk, Dineswil, Paul Wilde, David Luggan.
That's where they was, that's where they was working at.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
